items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: I would go to Ronnie Scott’s to hear Stan Getz

ctx.x: Is there anything that you’d like to wrap up with about what you do?

Well the only thing is that it’s always been a parallel life. I’ve had serious jobs in industry. I mean I was the director of a public company. That was, if you like, how I made my living and paid the bills and raised my family. But there was always this parallel life. And while I was working for the Melody Maker, which I did for about fifteen years, I was always a freelance. I was what is called a stringer.
